subject: Future Tech
title: Bioprinting Basics
description: A quick, practical guide to Bioprinting Basics.

hook.text: Bioprinters use living cells as ink.

buildup.text: Cells are mixed into a gel called bioink.

discovery.text: Organovo printed the first functional liver tissue in 2014.

twist.text: Printing a full organ requires blood vessels to feed every cell.

punchline.text: Printing cells is possible. Keeping them alive is the challenge.

quiz.question: What is the biggest obstacle to printing full organs?
